name: refrigeration_cycle_basic_r134a
title: Basic vapour-compression refrigeration cycle (R134a)
summary: R134a refrigeration machine between -10 °C (evaporator) and 20 °C (condenser) with 6 K subcooling, 2 K superheat and a compressor of 0.75 isentropic efficiency driven by a 0.80-efficiency motor; computes the refrigerant flow rate, compressor power and COP for 50 kW of cooling.

authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise)

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/refrigeration1.EES, EES 9.920)
verification.notes: 29/39 variables identical (<= 0.07 %); the 10 absolute enthalpies/entropies differ by constant reference-state offsets (148.15 kJ/kg on h, 795.69 J/kg-K on s_1, EES vs CoolProp R134a); all derived results (flow rate, powers, COP, temperatures, quality) agree within 0.013 %. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/refrigeration1.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
